claimEvidence: Source graded moderate (dm own-brand page, sourceKind manufacturer_de): 'Duschgel & Shampoo für empfindliche Haut'; 'Seine seifenfreie Rezeptur ist speziell für trockene sowie empfindliche Haut und Kopfhaut entwickelt worden' - one E2 unit naming dry and sensitive scalp states (counts for both, E2a); 'Das Duschgel & Shampoo schützt zudem vor Juckreiz, der durch Trockenheit entstehen kann' - sensitive (itch) unit acting on the scalp/skin state.
'Schützt vor dem Austrocknen', 'kann dem Austrocknen von Haut und Haar entgegenwirken' - protective; 'ph-hautneutral'.
No dandruff claim; no frequency or reset wording; directions 'Dusche + Shampoo'.
ID-3: '5% Urea' -> Urea @3, 'Allantoin' @9, 'Provitamin B5' -> Panthenol @8. No conflict.
Product is a shower gel + shampoo 2-in-1 (body and hair).

cleansingStrength.rationale: Moderate: C1 chassis, Sodium Laureth Sulfate @2 with prominent buffer Cocamidopropyl Betaine @4, no reinforcing strong anionic (C3, C4, C1). Coco-Glucoside @14 is post-fragrance and recorded only.
cleansingStrength.counterSignal: Humectant-rich formula; single betaine buffer still satisfies C1 moderate.

conditioningLevel.rationale: Moderate: several light routes - a prominent humectant cluster (Urea @3, Glycerin @5, Sodium Lactate @7, Panthenol @8) with a post-fragrance guar @17, Glycol Distearate @15 and weak refatters (Glyceryl Oleate @13, Hydrogenated Palm Glycerides Citrate @18, Lecithin @19). C2 not met (no prominent silicone or payload lipid). The only slip agent is post-fragrance, so low is the realistic neighbor.
